Marketing.metaDescription: Self-hosted German language learning for everyday life in Germany.
Marketing.headline: Learn German for the situations that actually matter.
Marketing.body: Practice Bürgeramt dialogues, turn documents into vocabulary decks, and find a Sprachcafé — all on a stack you host yourself.

Learning.sampleDialogue: Guten Tag, ich hätte gerne einen Termin beim Bürgeramt.
